نحتمي (form VIII)
# نَحْتَمِي (naḥtamī) /naħ.ta.miː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# نَحْتَمِيَ (naḥtamiya) /naħ.ta.mi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
